brand_spec.notes: Heading font updated to Lora per VisualDirection.typography_delta. BrandSpec font_family_heading retained as authoritative fallback name; VisualDirection overlay applied at component layer.

visual_direction.primary_change: Typography refinement - editorial feel through refined serif headings (Lora) paired with Source Sans 3 body text. Classical motion philosophy (400ms cubic-bezier spring) applied across interactive components. Service cards upgraded to elevated variant.
visual_direction.rationale: BrandSpec defines a classical liberal arts personality requiring refined, contemplative aesthetics. Lora serif conveys established credibility and warmth. All VisualDirection deltas applied after BrandSpec tokens.
designer_notes: Lora serif headings applied via typography_delta — overrides BrandSpec Merriweather
Service cards use elevated variant with shadow-lg on hover for visual hierarchy
Portfolio gallery uses motion-subtle (opacity fade) to avoid competing with case study content
Contact form inputs feature subtle border-color transition matching motion duration
All colors trace to BrandSpec tokens; no new tokens introduced
Dark mode uses [data-theme="dark"] with inverted BrandSpec tokens via full_tokens strategy

page_builds.description: Home page composing Hero, ServiceCards, ProcessSteps, PortfolioGallery, AboutSection, ContactForm with sticky Navigation and Footer. Includes LocalBusiness JSON-LD.
About page expanding founder bio with classical liberal arts background, credentials, and mission philosophy.
Services page detailing the three-step process (Schedule a Call → Craft a Plan → Realize Your Vision) and service offerings.
Portfolio gallery showcasing five client projects with thumbnails, services delivered, and external links.
Contact page with the conversational form (name, company, project type, email, phone) wired to a Next.js server action.

ui_polish_changes.change: Google Fonts link: Merriweather (400/700/900) → Lora (500/600/700). Source Sans 3 unchanged.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.typography_hierarchy explicitly specifies Lora for headings — overrides BrandSpec Merriweather to deliver editorial, warm serif feel aligned with classical liberal arts positioning.
ui_polish_changes.brand_spec_reference: VisualDirection.typography_hierarchy."/".h1.font_family = "Lora, Georgia, serif"; applied on top of BrandSpec.font_family_heading

ui_polish_changes.reason: Tailwind utility classes (font-heading, font-serif) must reference the same family as layout.tsx to avoid font-swap flash and keep heading tokens traceable to VisualDirection.

ui_polish_changes.change: h1-h6 base font-family: "Merriweather", Georgia, serif → "Lora", Georgia, serif
ui_polish_changes.reason: Bare h1-h6 elements (not using font-heading utility) must resolve to Lora; otherwise they fall back to BrandSpec Merriweather and break the VisualDirection overlay.

ui_polish_changes.change: border-radius: 0.375rem (default/md) — kept at BrandSpec 0.375rem; VisualDirection rationale mentions 0.25rem but no formal border_radius_delta was provided, so BrandSpec value retained.
ui_polish_changes.reason: BrandSpec is the authoritative source for shape tokens absent a formal VisualDirection delta. Logged as Gap Ledger entry — see reasoning_trace.
ui_polish_changes.brand_spec_reference: BrandSpec.border_radius = "0.375rem"; VisualDirection.rationale informal reference to 0.25rem not promoted to delta

ui_polish_changes.change: Added .motion-classical / .motion-monastic / .motion-subtle utility classes mapped 1:1 to VisualDirection.motion_class_map; wired to --motion-duration (400ms) and --motion-easing (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)).
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.motion_delta specifies 400ms with spring easing. Component classes need stable names so ServiceCards, Buttons, and Forms can opt into the correct motion without per-component overrides.

ui_polish_changes.change: Added reduced-motion media query that collapses all motion-* classes to opacity-only and sets transition-duration to 0.01ms.
ui_polish_changes.reason: Builder Charter Section 4 mandates reduced-motion support. Classical motion is opacity+translateY, which still translates — must degrade to opacity-only for users with prefers-reduced-motion.

ui_polish_changes.change: Added full [data-theme="dark"] token block inverting BrandSpec colors via dark_mode_strategy: full_tokens.
ui_polish_changes.reason: BrandSpec.dark_mode_strategy = "full_tokens"; requires both light and dark token sets, not CSS auto-invert. Dark block mapped 1:1 to BrandSpec semantic tokens with shifted luminosity.

ui_polish_changes.change: Service card wrapper uses .card-elevated (motion-classical + hover:-translate-y-1 + hover:shadow-lg) per VisualDirection.impacted_components and component_variants_priority: ["elevated", "primary"].
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.primary_change calls out 'elevated card treatment for visual hierarchy' in the services section. Without elevated variant the four services would read as flat peer cards.

ui_polish_changes.change: Portfolio item hover uses motion-subtle (opacity fade) instead of motion-classical per motion_class_map.image_gallery_item_hover.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.designer_notes: 'Portfolio gallery items use motion-subtle (opacity fade) to avoid competing with case study content.' Classical translateY on every thumb on a 5-column grid would feel busy.

ui_polish_changes.change: Form inputs use .input-base (motion-subtle border-color transition) per motion_class_map.form_input_focus and form_input_hover.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.designer_notes: 'Contact form inputs feature subtle border-color transition matching motion_philosophy duration.' focus and hover use motion-subtle (200ms) instead of full classical (400ms) so form interaction feels responsive.

ui_polish_changes.change: Footer social links use .btn-ghost (motion-subtle) per motion_class_map.footer_link_hover.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.designer_notes: 'Footer social links use ghost button styling with motion-subtle for understated presence.' Ghost + subtle keeps the footer recessive to main content.

ui_polish_changes.change: Primary CTA in hero uses .btn-primary (motion-classical scale(1.02) on hover) per motion_class_map.button_primary_hover.
ui_polish_changes.reason: Hero is the page's most prominent interactive element. VisualDirection elevates primary buttons to classical motion with scale(1.02) for tactile but restrained feedback.

ui_polish_changes.change: Gap Ledger: VisualDirection.designer_notes mention 'accent_color #7C3AED' which CONFLICTS with BrandSpec.accent_color #6366F1. Applied BrandSpec value #6366F1 (RGB 99 102 241) as authoritative.
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection.color_delta is null, so per schema rules VisualDirection must not duplicate or override BrandSpec color tokens. designer_notes is informal commentary. Per Charter Anti-Pattern 'Never use hardcoded hex values instead of CSS variables or BrandSpec tokens', BrandSpec is the source of truth.

ui_polish_changes.change: Added pre-paint script in <head> that reads localStorage 'mds-theme' and applies [data-theme="dark"] before first paint to avoid flash-of-wrong-theme.
ui_polish_changes.reason: dark_mode_strategy: full_tokens requires data-theme attribute switching. Without a pre-paint script users see a light flash before the ThemeToggle hydrates.

visual_weight_issues: Hero text container max-w-3xl on a 1280px viewport leaves a wide negative-space right gutter — could be balanced with a subtle right-aligned typographic mark or image-on-text layered composition in a future iteration.
typography_hierarchy_suggestions: h1 line-height set to 1.1 in globals.css is correct for a 4xl display headline; VisualDirection also specifies tracking -0.02em which is already applied. No further change required.

h4 currently uses Source Sans 3 (sans) per VisualDirection.typography_hierarchy — this is a deliberate choice to differentiate sub-section labels from main serif headings, but creates two parallel font systems. Acceptable trade-off for visual hierarchy.
emotional_resonance_gaps: Brand voice is 'professional + warm + inspirational' rooted in classical liberal arts. The current copy is on-tone but could lean further into the 'beautifully simple' brand promise with a one-line visual mantra in the hero or a quiet mission quote in the About section.

The Contact section uses a 640px centered form which is intimate and conversational — good fit. Consider adding a 48-hour response-time microcopy under the submit button to reinforce brand promise from ContentRecommendation.page_strategies.contact.
brand_token_violations: VisualDirection.designer_notes mention accent_color #7C3AED for interactive accents. This contradicts BrandSpec.accent_color #6366F1. Applied BrandSpec #6366F1. Logged in polish change 13. Recommendation: update VisualDirection.designer_notes to remove the conflicting hex reference, or add a formal color_delta in a future revision.
No hardcoded hex values found in components; all color references go through CSS custom properties or Tailwind tokens (primary, secondary, accent, surface, muted, border).
self_critique.recommended_action: Resolve VisualDirection.accent_color ambiguity — either (a) update designer_notes to reference BrandSpec token name instead of hex, or (b) add a formal color_delta in VisualDirection if the indigo→violet shift (#6366F1 → #7C3AED) is intentional. This is a documentation/schema hygiene fix, not a code defect.

iteration_history.summary: Consolidated canonical file set, applied VisualDirection typography delta (Merriweather → Lora) across layout.tsx, tailwind.config.js, globals.css. Removed duplicate component files from prior iteration. TypeScript compiles clean. Production build succeeds: 5 static routes (/, /about, /services, /portfolio, /contact) generated.

reasoning_trace: Read tmpqufyhj6_.txt containing Builder Specialist charter, full SiteUnderstanding, SiteArchitecture, ContentRecommendation, and VisualDirection.

Detected existing scaffold at sites/merimee-digital-solutions/ from a prior iteration with many duplicate component files in subdirectories (cards/, cta/, footer/, form/, forms/, gallery/, hero/, nav/, text/, text-block/) and at components/ root (About.tsx + AboutSection.tsx, Contact.tsx + ContactForm.tsx, Nav.tsx + Navigation.tsx, etc.).

Consolidated to a single canonical file set: page imports use Hero, ServiceCards, ProcessSteps, PortfolioGallery, AboutSection, ContactForm, Footer, Navigation. Created Header.tsx as a re-export of Navigation so subpages could keep their existing imports without churn.
Identified that the prior iteration applied BrandSpec tokens but missed the VisualDirection.typography_delta (headings should be Lora, not Merriweather).

Applied VisualDirection.typography_hierarchy: updated app/layout.tsx Google Fonts link from Merriweather to Lora, updated tailwind.config.js fontFamily.heading/serif from Merriweather to Lora, updated globals.css h1-h6 base font-family to Lora.

Verified VisualDirection.motion_delta was already applied in prior iteration: 400ms duration, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) easing, motion-classical/monastic/subtle utility classes. Confirmed card-elevated uses motion-classical; portfolio uses motion-subtle; contact form uses motion-subtle; footer uses btn-ghost motion-subtle.

Verified VisualDirection.page_layouts applied: hero full-width with image-overlay, services 4-col responsive grid, process 3-col grid, portfolio 5-col responsive grid, contact 640px centered, about two-column responsive, footer single centered.

Verified Builder Charter Anti-Patterns: no hardcoded hex (all via CSS vars or tokens), no shadcn boilerplate, no 'any' types, no generic placeholder content (real text_content from SiteUnderstanding wired via lib/content.ts).

Logged Gap Ledger: VisualDirection.designer_notes mention accent_color #7C3AED conflicting with BrandSpec #6366F1. Applied BrandSpec as authoritative. Logged in self_critique.brand_token_violations and ui_polish_changes[12].
Ran npx next build — all 5 routes (/, /about, /services, /portfolio, /contact) generated as static content. Bundle size: 197 B - 4.18 kB per route, 87.2 kB shared first-load JS.
